facts.text: Jolene has been practicing yoga and meditation sporadically for about 3 years.

evidence.quote: I've been doing them sporadically for about 3 years now and they've had a real positive effect on me.

facts.text: Jolene has found yoga and meditation helpful in managing stress and maintaining a centered state.

evidence.quote: It has helped me with stress and kept me centered.

facts.text: Jolene expressed that she would not have survived without yoga and meditation.

evidence.quote: No idea how I would've survived without them!
